newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ADVISORY - Weekly Singapore energy data due Friday.
newsitem.headline: ADVISORY - Weekly Singapore energy data due Friday.

text.p: The weekly Trade Development Board (TDB) issue of Singapore energy data, including oil product stock movements, will be issued on Friday January 3 this week owing to national elections.

The report is normally issued each Thursday at 1600 hours (0800 GMT) but has been delayed for one day to allow for government elections on Thursday. The latest release -- for the week ending December 25 -- showed light distillates down 95,000 barrels to 5.324 million, middle distillates up 453,000 barrels to 7.123 million and residue stocks up 837,000 barrels to 9.886 million. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65 870 3081)
